description: Patches: AI-drafts title AND metaDescription for up to 10 pages in one call. This is a MUTATION and costs one AI-gateway operation per field per page (up to 20) — never a bulk discount. One page/field failing is reported in that entry's own error without sinking the rest of the batch. Requires an org admin.

pageUrls.description: 1-10 crawled page URLs to draft title+metaDescription patches for.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: batch_draft_patches
